title: Claude Dispatch — Mobile Remote Control for Desktop Claude Cowork Sessions
description: Anthropic shipped Claude Dispatch on March 17, 2026 as a research preview inside Claude Cowork. Dispatch enables a single persistent Claude agent session running on a desktop to be controlled from a mobile phone. The architecture: one long-running Claude session stays on the desktop computer; the user messages it from their phone (via the Claude mobile app), and returns to find completed work. Currently limited to Max plan subscribers. Mac-based sandboxed Cowork sessions only at launch. Key characteristics: (1) Not a new Claude Code CLI feature — this is a Claude.ai product feature in the Cowork environment; (2) Enables async delegation: kick off long tasks on desktop from mobile, then check back; (3) Research preview status — behavior and availability may change. Integration relevance: the pattern is interesting for the workspace setup (requiem desktop + phone access via Tailscale SSH) but Dispatch is a proprietary Claude.ai UI feature, not an API or MCP. Monitor for: Dispatch expanding to API, webhook notifications, or programmatic triggering.

redundancy_check.notes: Nothing like Claude Dispatch in registry. Closest items are Claude Remote Control (already evaluated) and phone access via Tailscale SSH (custom setup). Dispatch is Anthropic's own UI-layer async delegation feature — different architectural layer.

evaluation.reasoning: Not integrable — Claude Dispatch is a Claude.ai UI product feature, not a CLI/API/MCP capability. Mac-only Cowork sessions at launch; workspace runs Linux (requiem). Research preview status. The async delegation pattern is conceptually interesting but the workspace already achieves this via Tailscale SSH + tmux sessions (phone → SSH → Claude Code). No actionable integration path exists today. Move to pipeline/future/ for monitoring; re-evaluate when/if Dispatch expands to API or cross-platform support.
